title: Object Oriented Programming II: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Discuss any five object orientation concepts.
By giving one example for each, explain the three main classes used in creating a GUI.
What are the advantages of using inheritance in programming?
What is an icon? Write down a simple Java code to create an image icon from an image file.
Write a Java program that prompts the user to enter three numbers and then displays the largest.
Describe any three features that distinguish C programming from Java programming.

A Makini investment pays an interest of 12% per annum on member deposits. Write a Java program that accepts the customer name, deposits and duration in years, then calculates and displays the total deposits. Note: all the deposits at the end of the year are carried over to the next year and the new amount becomes the deposit for the next year.
Discuss the difference between pass by value and pass by reference as used in Java functions.
Discuss class constructors in Java. Use the constructor concept to write a program that will calculate the volume of a cylinder (Vol = 3.142 x r x h) where r is the radius and h is the height.
Write a simple Java applet program to display the message "Welcome to Java Applet" at the (40, 20) coordinates.
Write a simple Java program and describe each of its components.
Java is machine dependent. Explain this concept in relation to other programming languages such as C and C++.
Explain the following three object oriented principles and how they are implemented in the Java language.
What are interfaces in Java? Discuss any one advantage and one disadvantage of using interfaces in Java.
Briefly explain the general format of interfaces in Java with a simple Java program.
